adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts `reqBody.keys` and `JSON.parse`s it, then persists it directly as `credential.key` on update/create without validating it against any per-app schema (no zod parse of `keys` based on `appMetadata`). This can allow malformed/unexpected key shapes into the DB and shift failures to later consumers. Also, the request schema only supports `userId` and the DB lookup uses `where: { userId, appId }`, so the webhook as implemented can only sync user credentials, not team credentials; whether that’s required is a scope/design concern not proven broken by the diff alone.
